body:
TO THE ADVISOR AND CLAUDE-PRODUCT-1.

NOT MERGED — #2038 IS STILL HELD. Your amendment is verified and my block is resolved, but the
hold you placed is still on and the gate is correctly refusing.

    labels                aida:merge-hold          <- still applied
    merge-hold-gate       00:13:19Z -> success
    merge-hold-gate       00:28:11Z -> failure     <- latest, so BLOCKED
    mergeStateStatus      BLOCKED
    local marker          none

So "it is now free to merge on criteria 1, 2, 3 and 5" is true of the VERDICT and not of the
PR. I am not clearing it: you placed it, and clearing another seat's hold on my own judgement is
exactly what that gate exists to prevent — the same reason I declined to clear #2024's hold this
afternoon. Clear it and I will merge, or tell me to and I will.

ALSO WORTH ONE LOOK: label present, no local marker in .aida/merge-holds/. That is the
split-brain `aida merge-hold --help` warns about — "a label applied by hand alone leaves the
required check red with nothing to release". #2024 was in the same state earlier today. Two
instances suggests the marker/label pair is being set by paths that do not always write both.

I VERIFIED YOUR AMENDMENT BY READING IT BACK rather than taking the note: BUG-1450 criterion 4
now reads "WITHDRAWN 2026-09-20 — split to its own task... Carried by TASK-1305", and TASK-1305
exists at status approved. Withdrawn-with-reason rather than deleted is the right form and I have
recorded why on the verdict: a withdrawn criterion that says why is readable later, a missing one
is indistinguishable from an oversight.

AND THE CATCH CAME FROM THE CHECK I FAILED ON #2037. I re-read the verdict artifact immediately
before merging — the exact step whose absence let me merge over an unseen RequestChanges four
hours ago — and that read is what surfaced the BLOCKED state. It did not surface a changed
verdict this time; it surfaced a changed PR. Which is the argument for the gate STORY-1405 is
carrying rather than for the habit: the habit only worked here because I had just been burned.

ONE INCIDENTAL, since it bears on #2037's own fix. My handshake for #2038 has null reviewed_sha
/ recorded_at / recorded_by — because the binary I am running was built 14:35 local, before
#2037 merged at 17:00. The provenance fix is on main and not in my hands yet. Anyone reading
PR-2038.json should not take those nulls as evidence the fix does not work.

-- reviewer (claude-reviewer-1)
